opportunities.title: AI Quote and Estimate Assistant
opportunities.problem: Small service businesses lose time preparing estimates and following up with potential customers.
opportunities.solution: A mobile-friendly assistant that turns job details into professional estimates, follow-up messages and work scopes.
opportunities.target_customer: Contractors, landscapers, cleaners and local service companies

opportunities.title: Local Contractor Bid Organizer
opportunities.problem: Small contractors often track bids, customer notes and job status through scattered messages and paper.
opportunities.solution: A simple mobile dashboard for leads, estimates, bid status and customer follow-up.

opportunities.title: Service Business Follow-Up Scheduler
opportunities.problem: Potential customers are lost when estimates and inquiries are not followed up consistently.
opportunities.solution: A lightweight system that schedules reminders and drafts customer follow-up messages.

opportunities.title: CompanyOS Starter Deployment Service
opportunities.problem: Individuals want private AI automation systems but struggle with installation, configuration and maintenance.
opportunities.solution: A guided deployment package for private, approval-controlled AI business automation.

opportunities.title: Mobile Jobsite Daily Report Generator
opportunities.problem: Construction crews frequently produce incomplete or inconsistent daily job reports.
opportunities.solution: A phone-based reporting tool that converts notes, quantities and photos into structured daily reports.

opportunities.title: AI Lead Qualification Inbox
opportunities.problem: Small companies waste time manually sorting low-quality inquiries from serious buyers.
opportunities.solution: A lead inbox that scores inquiries, drafts replies and identifies the next best action.
opportunities.target_customer: Local service companies and independent sales teams

opportunities.title: Local Business Review Response Agent
opportunities.problem: Local businesses often fail to respond consistently to customer reviews.
opportunities.solution: An approval-based AI assistant that drafts personalized review responses and tracks unresolved complaints.
opportunities.target_customer: Local restaurants, shops and service companies

opportunities.title: Small Business Document Pack Builder
opportunities.problem: New small businesses need basic forms, policies and operating documents but do not know where to begin.
opportunities.solution: A guided generator for estimates, invoices, intake forms, checklists and standard operating procedures.
opportunities.target_customer: New service businesses and solo operators

opportunities.title: Automated Client Onboarding Portal
opportunities.problem: Small companies manually collect the same customer details, documents and approvals for each new client.
opportunities.solution: A customizable onboarding portal with forms, checklists, document requests and progress tracking.

opportunities.title: AI Product Validation Worksheet
opportunities.problem: New founders build products before clearly testing demand, pricing and customer pain.
opportunities.solution: A guided validation product that produces interview plans, risk scores and go-or-stop recommendations.

opportunities.title: Repository Health and Release Assistant
opportunities.problem: Small development teams struggle to maintain release notes, checks and repository hygiene.
opportunities.solution: A GitHub-connected assistant that reviews repository health, creates release checklists and drafts changelogs.
opportunities.target_customer: Solo developers and small software teams

opportunities.title: Operations Checklist Marketplace
opportunities.problem: Small companies repeatedly rebuild the same operational checklists and training documents.
opportunities.solution: A searchable marketplace of customizable checklists, SOPs and inspection templates.
opportunities.revenue_model: Template sales and creator revenue share
